author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬದುಕುವುದು ಸಾಧನೆಯು ಪರಮಪದ ಸೋಪಾನ
ಎದುರಿಸುತ ನೀನಡೆಯೊ ಕಷ್ಟ ನಷ್ಟಗಳ
ಬದಿಗಿರಿಸು ನೋವುಗಳ ಸಾಧನೆಗೆ ಅಡ್ಡಿಯಹು
ನಿಧಿಯಾಗು ಪೀಳಿಗೆಗೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Living is itself a spiritual practice, a stair to the highest state;
walk on, facing hardship and loss;
set aside the pains that block your practice,
and become a treasure for the generations to come, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Life itself is the practice that leads upward. Meet hardship and loss, don’t let pain stop you, and leave something of value for those who come after.
